title: Subset Sum reduces to Partition
statement: Let $U$ be a finite type, let $w : U \to \bbn$ be a weight function, and let $T \in \bbn$ be a target satisfying $T \le \sum_{a} w(a)$. Write $W = \sum_{a} w(a)$, and form the weight function on the augmented universe $U \oplus \mathrm{Bool}$ that assigns weight $w(a)$ to each original item $a$, weight $2W - T$ to one added dummy item, and weight $W + T$ to a second added dummy item. Then some subset of $U$ has total $w$-weight exactly $T$ if and only if the augmented universe admits a partition into two parts of equal total weight.
hypotheses_covered: w : U → ℕ is a weight function on a finite type U
conclusion is an iff between SubsetSum(w,T) and Partition of the augmented weight function
replaced:

Sum instance $(w, T)$ is solvable if and only if the Partition instance with weight
